title: Preserving rare-item recall under a storage budget: quantization, distillation, and the limits of teacher fidelity
abstract: arXiv:2610.36267v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Under a fixed embedding-storage budget, recommenders can use a small full-precision model, a distilled student, or a higher-rank low-precision model. We asked which choice preserves rare-item recall and whether teacher fidelity reflects it in seven dataset-backbone cells: matrix factorization on Gowalla, Last.fm, Amazon Video Games, Steam, Goodbooks-10k and MovieLens-20M, and LightGCN on Amazon Video Games. Seven candidates fit in 168 bytes per user or item row: 40-dimensional Bayesian personalized ranking (BPR), two 40-dimensional unbiased knowledge distillation (UnKD) students, and factorizations of a 300-dimensional teacher's scores at ranks 40, 80, 155 and 300, stored in 32, 16, 8 and 4 bits. Each test set was evaluated once after fixing candidates and confirmatory analyses. translated_title: 在存储预算下保持稀有物品召回率：量化、蒸馏与教师保真度的局限
translated_abstract: 在固定的嵌入存储预算下，推荐系统可以使用小型全精度模型、蒸馏学生模型，或更高秩的低精度模型。我们在七个数据集-骨干组合中研究了哪种选择能够保持稀有物品的召回率，以及教师保真度能否反映这一点：这七个组合包括在Gowalla、Last.fm、Amazon Video Games、Steam、Goodbooks-10k和MovieLens-20M上的矩阵分解，以及在Amazon Video Games上的LightGCN。七个候选方案均符合每用户或物品行168字节的存储限制：40维贝叶斯个性化排序（BPR）、两个40维无偏知识蒸馏（UnKD）学生模型，以及对一个300维教师模型评分在秩40、80、155和300处进行分解并以32、16、8和4位存储的方案。在确定候选方案并完成验证性分析后，每个测试集仅评估一次。结果表明，秩300的4位分解仅使用教师模型13%的存储，就在所有组合中保留了教师模型95-103%的尾部recall@20和93-97%的NDCG@20。秩40的分解……
tldr: 在每行168字节的固定存储预算下，对300维教师模型评分进行秩300的4位低精度分解仅需教师存储的13%，即可在全部七个数据集-骨干组合中保留教师95-103%的稀有物品召回率，优于小型全精度模型和蒸馏学生模型，且教师保真度并不可靠地反映稀有物品召回的保留情况。
en_tdlr: Under a fixed 168-byte-per-row embedding storage budget, a rank-300 4-bit factorization of a 300-dimensional teacher's scores uses only 13% of teacher storage yet retains 95-103% of its rare-item recall@20 across all seven dataset-backbone cells, outperforming small full-precision and distilled student models, and showing that teacher fidelity does not reliably reflect tail-recall preservation.
